Name: Mac OS X NFS Mount Privilege Escalation Exploit
Description: This exploit leverages a stack buffer overflow vulnerability to escalate privileges. The vulnerable function nfs_convert_old_nfs_args does not verify the size of a user-provided argument before copying it to the stack. As a result, by passing a large size as an argument, a local user can overwrite the stack with arbitrary content. Mac OS X Lion Kernel <= xnu-1699.32.7 except xnu-1699.24.8 are affected.
Targets: Mac OS X 10.7 Lion x64 (Native Payload)
